Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the collected death dates and drew the wrong conclusion—stating George William Whitaker died first and swapping the dates (assigning 1698 to Whitaker and 1916 to Sheppard). The sources showed Fleetwood Sheppard died in 1698 and George William Whitaker in 1916, so Sheppard died first.
